business_problem: For Vattenfall to contribute in the best possible way to a fossil-free future, tackling the existing data structure was key. In order to meet these multilayered challenges, a platform technology had to be found that was capable of guaranteeing high-performance parallel processing and at the same time offered many options for connecting a wide variety of source systems out of the box.
solution_summary: Vattenfall is one of the largest utilities in Germany and a leading power producer in Europe. Its German hydropower business plays an integral part in reaching the goal of fossil-free living within one generation. With infrastructure built on Databricks and expertise from initions the business unit was able to outgrow the multiple separate on-prem solutions that existed before. The European energy market is constantly changing. This leads to more complexity in the markets and also to entirely new markets. For Vattenfall to contribute in the best possible way to a fossil-free future, tackling the existing data structure was key. And creating actionable insights from a unified data platform was necessary to ensure reliable data accessibility and quality, near real-time data availability and also to enable analytics and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Databricks SQL
solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, self-service queries, and business intelligence for downstream users.

data_flow: Operational, customer, and transactional data lands in Databricks, is transformed in the lakehouse, and is served to downstream users and applications through Databricks SQL.
business_outcome: Reported outcomes include 30x Faster data availability (30 seconds instead of 15 minutes).
